AnalyticsIQ: Turning player data into growth decisions
Tomas Hubka
Last updated: Sep 03, 2026
min read
GameAnalytics has evolved. With the new IQ Suite, we’re transforming years of data expertise into a connected set of tools that help studios of every size understand their players, refine their strategy, and grow with confidence.
Updated April 2026 — now covering AnalyticsIQ Pro features with video walkthroughs.
‍
GameAnalytics has evolved. With the new IQ Suite, we're transforming years of data expertise into a connected set of tools that help studios of every size understand their players, refine their strategy, and grow with confidence.
Fourteen years ago, we started with analytics. Today, we have grown into a full ecosystem of tools for developers, marketers, and growth teams, built to give every studio the kind of power that used to be reserved for the biggest publishers. Forget the patchwork of disconnected tools. Our four specialized products work together, giving you a unified way to analyze, test, and grow your games. At the heart of it all:
AnalyticsIQ
.
GameAnalytics is as important to us as a radar when you're flying at night, through a thunderstorm; without it, we'd be flying blind.
- Eric Park, Co-founder at Trihex Studio
What is AnalyticsIQ?
Guessing is costly. Decisions should be backed by data, not gut feeling. AnalyticsIQ helps developers and studios understand player behavior and turn it into concrete actions that improve acquisition, retention, and monetization.
It's cross-platform (
mobile
,
Roblox
,
PC/console
,
VR/AR
), scalable from indie teams to AAA studios, and designed to give clarity to both technical and non-technical teams. Player behavior is complex — players churn for different reasons, convert at different points, and spend differently depending on source, platform, or feature exposure. AnalyticsIQ transforms that complexity into a clear story about your players, so you can fix what's broken, double down on what works, and grow with confidence.
Happy to use AnalyticsIQ for all of our products. Very convenient and easy to use tools give us important and detailed information to understand in-game data.
- Igor Karev, CEO at Tatem Games
How developers use AnalyticsIQ
AnalyticsIQ covers three main use cases: acquisition, engagement & retention, and monetization.
Acquisition: Optimize spend with end-to-end player insights
UA spend is rising, and every dollar counts. With AnalyticsIQ, you can connect your campaigns directly to in-game behavior.
Track campaign impact with precision:
See which ads, creatives, or networks are driving installs, and whether those users actually engage and spend.
Go beyond installs:
Funnels show how players from different campaigns move through tutorials, early levels, and monetization steps.
Measure true ROAS and ROI:
Cohorts let you compare retention, lifetime value, and monetization by source.
Integrate with attribution leaders such as Adjust, Appsflyer, Kochava, Singular, Tenjin, Airbridge.
AnalyticsIQ helps us gain a better understanding of our users' behaviour so we can keep improving our games. We love the amazing and easy-to-use dashboards!
- Sophie Jorgensen, Studio Manager at Copenhagen Creators
Learn more
Engagement & Retention: Build experiences worth returning to
Retention is the lifeblood of successful games. AnalyticsIQ helps you uncover what keeps players engaged and what drives them away.
Monitor key KPIs out of the box:
Daily retention, session length, and playtime all available in pre-built dashboards.
Spot drop-offs in onboarding and flows:
Funnels reveal exactly where players churn in tutorials, levels, or features.
Understand feature adoption:
Matrix shows which features players embrace and which get ignored.
Segment and personalize player experience with SegmentIQ. This complementary platform from our ecosystem can also run A/B tests and remote configs for tailored experiences.
Thanks to AnalyticsIQ, we make decisions about player engagement by using heaps of custom events with relative ease.
- Emre Tas, CEO at Alictus
Learn more
